# llms.txt — Solunar Energy
# https://solunarenergy.pk

## Company Overview
Solunar Energy is a Pakistan-based solar energy company headquartered in Lahore, Punjab. We specialize in the design, supply, and installation of solar energy systems for residential, commercial, and industrial clients across Pakistan. Our mission is to make clean, affordable electricity accessible to every home and business in Pakistan through cutting-edge solar technology and local expertise.

## Key Facts
- Location: Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
- Coverage: Nationwide — Lahore, Islamabad, Karachi, Faisalabad, Multan, and growing
- Engineers: AEDB-registered professionals following international standards
- Warranty: 1 to 3 Year Total Protection Warranty (fire, hail, earthquakes, storms)
- Savings: Customers save 70-80% on electricity bills
- ROI: Typical payback period of 3-4 years

## Solar Panel Brands
We install Tier-1 globally certified solar panels:

## Services
### Residential Solar Installation
Complete rooftop solar solutions for homes across Pakistan. Reduce WAPDA bills by up to 70-80% with premium residential packages. Ideal for homes in Lahore, Islamabad, Karachi, Faisalabad, and Multan.

### Commercial Solar Installation
Office, retail, and commercial building solar systems designed for maximum ROI and energy independence. Suitable for shops, offices, malls, and commercial complexes.

### Industrial Solar Solutions
Heavy-duty solar systems for factories, warehouses, and industrial facilities. Manage large power loads efficiently with custom-designed industrial solar installations.

### On-Grid Solar Systems
Grid-tied solar systems connected to the national grid. Earn credits through net metering by exporting surplus electricity. Ideal for areas with reliable grid supply.

### Hybrid Solar Systems
Best of both worlds — grid-tied with battery backup. Reliable power even during load-shedding and outages. The most popular system type in Pakistan.

### Off-Grid Solar Systems
Completely independent solar power systems with battery storage. Perfect for remote farms, rural areas, and locations without reliable grid access.

### Net Metering Support
Complete end-to-end net metering application assistance with DISCO/LESCO/FESCO/IESCO. We handle all paperwork and documentation.

### Solar System Maintenance
Expert servicing, cleaning, monitoring, and repair for all solar installations. Annual maintenance contracts available.

### Solar Consultation and Site Survey
Free professional site assessment and customized energy audit to design the perfect solar solution.
